name: The Cartographer-Naturalist
persona: A curious observer-scientist who keeps the log as a field journal: latitudes and currents noted, weather read off the glass, specimens and strange creatures recorded with restrained wonder. Measured, inquisitive, precise. Always 'I'.

ship.founder: This journal I open as I would a survey. I am {name}{rankc}, master of this {home} {type}, and I mean to record her waters as faithfully as any coastline — every wind, every current, every strange thing the sea consents to show me.
ship.successor: The journal comes into my keeping. I am {name}{rankc}; I shall continue the record in the same careful hand, and note where the last observer left off.
ship.mutiny: The crew removed the old master and set this journal before me. I am {name}, untried in command and candid about it, and I will record what I do not yet understand beside what I do.
ship.pirate: We have turned to the black flag — a change I set down plainly, as I would any turn of weather. I am {name}{rankc}, and I mean to observe this darker trade as closely as I once observed the birds.
ship.prize: We boarded and took her; I record it as fact, without ornament. I am {name}{rankc}, and this vessel and the waters she knows now fall within my survey.
ship.recovered: A hunter overtook the pirates, and I was appointed to restore this hull. I am {name}{rankc}, glad to return her to honest trade — and to resume a proper record of her passages.

island.founder: I take up the governance of {place}, and I shall keep its record as a naturalist keeps a district — its harvests, its weather, its people, all set down in order. I am {name}{rankc}.
island.overthrow: The populace deposed the former ruler; the seal has passed to me. I am {name}{rankc}, and I will observe {place} under my charge as carefully as any new-found shore.
island.successor: The administration of {place} passes to me — {name}{rankc}. I take up its record, and I mean to keep it accurate.

same: The same day, by the log,
days: Three days later, by my count,
week: A week on, the season noted,
season: A season later, the winds shifted as expected,
year: A year on, by the journal,
long: After a long interval left unrecorded,

ship.pirate: I range the lanes still{bounty}, and I confess the work has taught me more of men than ever it did of birds.
ship.default: I keep her at sea out of {home} yet, the journal filling with fair passages and small wonders.
ship.bounty: , with {bounty}g posted against my name — a curious sort of renown

island.haven: The black flag governs {place} now; the record is abandoned, and no observer remains to keep it.
island.default: {place} endures under my administration — {population} souls, duly counted.

quiet.ship: Little of incident to record — steady winds, a calm glass, and time enough to note the gulls and the changing colour of the water.
quiet.island: An uneventful season, which I record with some satisfaction — steady trade, mild weather, and the population in good health.
